│ When the music selection runs out (end of the album, playlist or artist), what should happen?

❯ 1. Repeat the selection
     Loop it. Shuffle modes reshuffle on each pass so the order is fresh.
  2. Stop
     Music stops when the selection ends. Listen keeps reading.
  3. Keep going library-wide
     Continue with the same mode across the whole library, e.g. shuffling albums from all artists.
  4. Type something.
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  5. Chat about this

Enter to select · Tab/Arrow keys to navigate · Esc to cancel
